name: action-wheel
title: Action Wheel
description: Radial action menu modeled on the Logi Options+ Actions Ring: a small gray close button in the center, a ring of solid circular actions, and a label card pushed outward from each one. Opens at the cursor on right-click via ActionWheelContextMenu. Actions with nested items open a submenu on an outer arc, and variant="arc" drops the ring for a launcher that fans actions toward a direction. Labels always, on hover, or off (tooltips), full ring or arc via startAngle and sweep, solid, violet, primary, secondary, and surface tones, compact, default, medium, and large sizes, and arrow-key navigation.
